name: length

N.expectation: All declared function parameters and Unicode/array/visible-object lengths in the asserted examples.

L.expectation: Reflection does not force defaults, body, array payloads, hidden fields or native callback.

B.expectation: Zero parameters, optional parameters and supplementary Unicode example.

remaining: Complete signature/arity/error-order and every container/visibility combination remain unreviewed.

name: sum

N.expectation: Empty sum, finite examples and cancellation without overflow.

E.expectation: Overflow is Runtime at the first invalid addition, before later operands or type inspection.

L.expectation: Unused binding, short circuit and hidden fields do not evaluate overflow.

B.expectation: Empty array and large finite/cancellation examples.

remaining: All element/argument types, signatures and evaluation orders are not fully adjudicated.

name: avg

E.expectation: Intermediate sum overflow fails before division/cancellation or consumers.

L.expectation: The average on the unselected right side of true || remains unforced.

B.expectation: Large finite operands that overflow the intermediate sum are rejected.

remaining: Empty/type/signature/error-order coverage outside these reviewed tests remains unadjudicated.

name: remove

N.expectation: Deleting a present element and the missing-element example preserve the original.

L.expectation: Length of deletion result does not force retained payload.

B.expectation: Missing element example leaves input/result unchanged.

remaining: Search/forcing/error and complete named-argument contracts are not adjudicated; legacy remove_test errors are not assumed normative.

name: removeAt

N.expectation: Positional deletion preserves original, aliases and earlier map/slice.

L.expectation: Result shares cached payload once; removed/retained error payloads stay lazy for length/other indices.

B.expectation: Deleting sole element and chained deletion keep inputs immutable.

remaining: Named parameter idx versus source at/current i is unresolved. Invalid/fractional/out-of-range index behavior is not assumed from Go tests.

name: manifestYamlDoc

L.expectation: Unused manifestation and hidden fields remain unforced.

remaining: All formatting/options/normal-result/numeric/layout boundaries are not adjudicated by this error/lazy subset.

name: manifestYamlStream

E.expectation: Errors and functions in any demanded document fail the stream call.

remaining: Official documentation c_document_end=false conflicts with source default true; normal/default/options/lazy/boundary behavior remains unresolved or unmapped.

name: type

signature_review.status: Required-only documented signature; missing/extra/unknown names fail only if called and do not force rejected argument values.

N.expectation: All seven documented type tags, including named x call.

E.expectation: Demanded outer error propagates; no input value type itself is invalid.

B.expectation: Empty containers, functions and Unicode values classified by outer type.

remaining: Exhaustive host-native/import/error-order combinations are not accepted by this finite subset.

name: isNumber

N.expectation: Only numbers return true; every other value type returns false, not a type error.

E.expectation: Outer error propagates; arity/naming rejection is in the common binding tests.

L.expectation: Nested error payloads/assertions/function bodies/defaults remain unforced.

B.expectation: Negative zero, minimum positive subnormal and maximum finite binary64 are numbers.

remaining: All host/source combinations remain outside this bounded review.

name: abs

E.expectation: Every nonnumeric value kind and demanded error rejected; invalid numeric producer fails first.

L.expectation: Unused binding/argument, branch, short circuit and hidden call remain unforced.

B.expectation: Numeric zero, negative zero, subnormal and finite extreme results stay finite.

remaining: Signed-zero output spelling is not adjudicated; no complete diagnostic-format claim.

name: sign

E.expectation: Every nonnumeric kind and needed error rejected; invalid producer propagates.

B.expectation: Both zeros, finite extremes and positive/negative subnormal signs.

remaining: No arbitrary-input host/diagnostic ordering proof.

name: min

signature_review.status: Required-only source/documented signature; named arguments reordered successfully.

N.expectation: Select lesser finite numeric value using fixed source comparison.

E.expectation: Each nonnumeric kind in either position rejected; overflow producer and demanded operand errors propagate.

L.expectation: Invalid first type stops before second expression; unused call controls in common tests.

B.expectation: Equal, zero, subnormal and maximum finite magnitudes without narrowing.

remaining: Signed-zero output/tie representation and all nested diagnostic combinations remain unadjudicated.

name: pow

signature_review.status: Required-only public documentation signature; formal mathematical metavariables do not rename parameters.

N.expectation: Positive, negative-integer, fractional exponent, reciprocal and zero-exponent real examples.

E.expectation: Nonnumeric inputs and non-real/overflow results fail, including before type/predicate/min/max consumers.

B.expectation: Finite large result, zero positive power, underflow-to-zero and negative bases with integer exponents.

remaining: pow(0,0), exhaustive rounding/domain/identity-forcing combinations remain unadjudicated.

name: range

signature_review.status: Required-only source/documentation signature; reordered named call succeeds.

E.expectation: Operand types and overflowing size arithmetic fail; needed parameters have no defaults.

L.expectation: Source parameter callback cached once across length/elements/slice alias; unused-call controls in common tests.

B.expectation: Zero/singleton length, integral-sized fractional intervals and finite starts beyond Int32 including +/-1e308.

remaining: Negative/nonintegral cardinalities and sizes exceeding host allocation bounds remain unadjudicated. Public source dispatch was fixed after two real failed groups.

name: map

signature_review.status: Required-only source/documentation signature; reordered named call succeeds.

N.expectation: Array or Unicode-string input yields an array of callback values; numeric/string results and unchanged array input.

E.expectation: Non-function/non-sequence and demanded callback/application errors fail.

L.expectation: Length avoids callback/payload execution for array/string inputs, unselected payloads stay lazy, repeated result callback executes once.

B.expectation: Empty array/string, supplementary Unicode codepoints and error payload selection.

remaining: Initial flatMap-like string expectations were corrected from fixed source; original false failures retained. Complete callback declaration/default/limit/error-order matrix remains unadjudicated.

name: filter

signature_review.status: Required-only documented signature; reordered named call succeeds.

N.expectation: True/false predicates select original elements while preserving input.

E.expectation: Non-array/non-function and demanded callback/application errors fail.

L.expectation: Predicates run but unused retained/excluded payloads stay lazy; native counter executes once per predicate.

B.expectation: Empty input, all-false, all-true with error payload, and lazy object fields.

remaining: Nonboolean predicate results are explicitly unresolved by this review, not treated as normative failures or Go-derived passes. Complete callback-declaration/default and resource-bound matrix remains pending.
